q1_issues.issue: sk_person_1 (the witness for "he") is referenced as a role filler but never typed - the required (Member sk_person_1 person) atom for an antecedent-less pronoun witness is missing.

"Inomaru" is capitalized, so by the instruction set's mechanical casing cue it is a proper noun and needs a name-derived symbol plus its non-optional (Name inomaru "Inomaru") fact; instead it is encoded as a common-noun kind with an sk_ witness and no Name atom.
The first conjunct "he is the ___" yields no atom at all (its complement is missing from the source), so nothing records that a copular predication was stated.

q2_gaps: "become" plus a predicative complement (a change-of-state copular verb) - "Two kinds of clause" splits only copular "is" from ordinary verbal clauses, and nothing specifies the subject role or how to attach the predicate nominal, so the parse improvised Patient-subject plus Theme-complement

no policy for an ungrammatical / truncated input: a sentence-initial dangling subordinator ("As ," with no clause after it) and an NP with an elided head ("is the") both have no prescribed handling, so both are silently dropped
notes: Dropping the stranded "As" is defensible since a connective atom needs two reified endpoints and there is no second clause here. (Can sk_become_1) and the reduced-relative treatment of "to borrow" (the modified noun filling its Theme slot) both follow the instruction set.
